content: International SOS provides specialized services in medical assistance, healthcare, security, and risk management to private organizations and government entities. Established in 1985 under the name AEA International, the organization has grown significantly and now employs approximately 5,000 individuals. Each year, it conducts around one million medical and security interventions, including approximately 12,000 evacuations and repatriations. International SOS operates nine regional centers located in Jakarta, Johannesburg, London, Moscow, Paris, Philadelphia, Singapore, Sydney, and Tokyo. These centers are supported by a network of alarm centers. The staff at these centers includes physicians, operations managers, multilingual coordinators, and logistics support personnel. Notably, about 35% of the organization’s workforce consists of medical professionals. The organization was originally founded as AEA International in 1985 by Pascal Rey-Herme and Arnaud Vaissié. Its initial focus was on delivering medical care and consulting services to multinational companies operating in the Asia-Pacific region. Over the subsequent decade, the company expanded from its base in Singapore and Indonesia to become a pan-Asian corporation, establishing operations in Hong Kong, Australia, Japan, and mainland China. By 1995, AEA International had launched subsidiaries in France and the United States. In 1998, the organization was officially renamed International SOS.
